Lina: Noticed 2 unexpected proration credits in NetSuite for VND-77 after today's cutover. Stripe has proration charge but no credits. NetSuite memos: CR-77-0301 and CR-77-0301-dup.
Zane: Can you paste the NS links and the Stripe invoice id so I can trace?
Lina: NS: https://ns.example.com/app/accounting/transactions/creditmemo.nl?id=556677
Lina: Stripe invoice: in_6M2b... shows a single prorate line of -$210. NetSuite has two credits totaling $420.
Ashley: Which job wrote these? nightly-batch or morning-replay?
Zane: Quick look at the ingestion trace: both the midnight-batch and the morning-replay processed the same webhook window. Our batching logic buckets webhooks by local_date (server TZ), but webhooks from Stripe use UTC created_at. When DST/offsets align, events near midnight fall into both buckets during a replay. midnight-batch used bucket key "2026-03-01" (server local) and morning-replay used UTC date "2026-03-01" leading to duplicate processing.
Priya: So two different jobs materialized the same proration as two NetSuite credit memos? what's the immediate ledger risk?
Ashley: Total credits: $420 across 1 vendor account (VND-77). GL impact: Unposted yet; NetSuite posting scheduled at end-of-day. I can flip those memos to Pending to prevent posting.
netsuite-admin: Done — set both memos to Pending Approval at 2260003310. Auto-post disabled for those memos.
billing-bot: job:nightly-batch paused by lina at 2260003330 :ok_hand:
Zane: Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Pause nightly-batch and replay queue (done).
2) Hotfix batching key to always use webhook.data.object.created (UTC) rather than server local_date. Small code change (~15m) and deploy.
3) Add a dedupe layer before ns-sync that checks for an existing NetSuite external_id or identical invoice.id mapping in the last 48h and rejects duplicates (configurable).
4) Manual remediation: netsuite-admin to void the duplicate credit memo once hotfix is deployed and we confirm idempotency.
Priya: Approve void for duplicate credit (VND-77 $210). I sign off for amounts <= $500. For >$500 we'd need finance ticket; this is under.
Ashley: I'll open NS change request and schedule the void for when you confirm hotfix. Also adding a saved search for memos created by "batch" jobs within +/- 1 hour of midnight.
Zane: Hotfix branch opened: fix/batch-key-utc (PR 428). Local tests show replayed webhooks near midnight now map to single UTC bucket.
Zane: Deploying hotfix to staging, will run controlled replay for the affected webhook ids: `evt_6M2b...` and confirm no second credit created.
billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/fix-batch-key-utc pushed by zane at 2260003402, CI green :rocket:
Zane: After deploy I reprocessed the single webhook in staging and only one NS memo was created as expected.
netsuite-admin: Will void CR-77-0301-dup after prod deploy and mark the original as reconciled. Need the list of external_ids to match.
Lina: I've attached the webhook ids and logs to FIN-3499 and added the event timestamps.
Priya: Thanks. Owners: Zane (code + deploy), Ashley (NS admin + void), Lina (monitoring + ticket). Target: hotfix deployed within 1h; void executed after deploy; confirm ledger clean within 6h.
Ashley: Saved search added and email alerts sent to Priya and Lina at 2260003475.
Lina: Confirmed alerts received. Closing once void done.
